decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program fits the firm's core psychiatric care mission and has its own web page, so with reimbursable demand it likely meets aspirations and warrants no search for alternatives.
The carpentry workshop is part of the sheltered workshop's occupational mission and is prominently presented, so slack and its social purpose support carrying it despite uncertain commercial results.

Outpatient sociotherapy complements the psychiatric services and draws statutory funding, but its low web visibility signals modest commitment, so the drop risk is moderate though below the threshold.
Senior living counseling is shown on the home page and feeds demand for the core residential care business, so it likely meets or exceeds aspirations.
The retail shop is only mentioned and may underperform commercially, but it gives a low-cost sales channel for workshop products, so management likely tolerates it given its link to the core mission.
